newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent sheds gains as longs liquidate positions.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent sheds gains as longs liquidate positions.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures fell sharply off highs in late trade as traders liquidated positions ahead of the weekend, floor brokers said.
"There's no headlines, it's just long liquidation," said one broker.
April Brent was trading 10 cents down at $19.60 a barrel at 1916 GMT, off a session high of $20.07.
"We broke through $20.00 but couldn't stay there so people are selling out," a dealer said.
NYMEX crude and products futures also retraced earlier gains made on the back of forecasts for cooler temperatures in the U.S. Northeast this weekend.
